production.note: US model years. First: AutoGuide (Craig Cole, 27 March 2013) says the car reaches dealers 'as a 2014 model' (autoguide-cla45-2014); MBUSA's 2014 CLA brochure covers the 'CLA 45 AMG' (mb-us-cla-brochure-2014). Last: MBUSA's 2019 CLA brochure lists the AMG CLA 45 (mb-us-cla-brochure-2019); no later C117 brochure was found. The 2020-on CLA 45 is the next generation (C118). Sold as the 'Mercedes-Benz CLA45 AMG' at launch and as the 'Mercedes-AMG CLA 45' later.

body.note: Four-door car Mercedes markets as a coupe ('Its four doors open to a roomy cabin'), recorded as a sedan. The CLA Shooting Brake was not sold in the US.

configuration.note: 'Handcrafted AMG 2.0-liter turbo Direct Injection gasoline inline-4'

displacementL.note: 1,991 cc per OPENERS' specification table (openers-cla45): '1,991 cc Inline-4 Twin-Scroll Turbo'. MBUSA states '2.0-liter'.

transmission.note: '7-speed AMG SPEEDSHIFT® DCT dual-clutch automatic'. No manual was offered.

powerHp.note: Quote (MBUSA 2016 CLA brochure): "375 hp @ 6,000 rpm". The 2017 and 2019 brochures give the same "375 hp @ 6,000 rpm" (mb-us-cla-brochure-2017, mb-us-cla-brochure-2019). The 2014 and 2015 models were rated 355 hp; 2015 brochure (mb-us-cla-brochure-2015): "Handcrafted 2.0-liter Direct Injection turbocharged AMG inline-4 355 hp @ 6,000 rpm". The 375 hp rating covered four of the six model years, so the reference year is 2016, its first year.

weightLb.note: US curb weight, 7-speed DCT (the only transmission), 2016 model. Quote (MBUSA 2016 CLA brochure): "Curb weight 3,450 lbs". The 2015, 2017 and 2019 brochures print the same "3,450 lbs"; the 2015 sheet has no estimate label.
